summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Evidence: Woot documentation proves API access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish rights for commercial/public collection, storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, trademarks, images, prices, or monetization. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains conditional when it preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence is missing. Existing progress is limited to official Woot API/terms/support review, partial repository/configuration evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft site terms. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked; obtain written rights or an API agreement and field-level limits, then obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed; produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry; capture consent, withdrawal, GA4 property/data-sharing, retention, and jurisdiction evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed; produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, subpoena, and data-subject-request inventory. Operational use is conditionally supportable; secondary disclosure or monetization is blocked.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue admission is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence by the existing deadline.

Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Do not treat incomplete analytics or revenue attribution as zero, and do not claim causal lift.
